newsitem.title: EU: EP INSTITUTIONAL AFFAIRS COMMITTEE AGENDA - SEPT 25-26.
newsitem.headline: EP INSTITUTIONAL AFFAIRS COMMITTEE AGENDA - SEPT 25-26.

text.p: Committee on Institutional Affairs [[ Wednesday 25 September 1996 ]] 0.1 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE218.750 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 8 and 9 July 1996 (PE218.741 ) - 24 and 25 July 1996 (PE218.745 ) - 2 and 3 September 1996 (PE218.750 ) 3. Chairman's announcements ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 4. Exchange of views with Mr Gay Mitchell, President-in-Office of the Council, on the development of the Intergovernmental Conference ([1] ) 5. CODECISION ([2] ) 5.1 Scope of the codecision procedure (Commission report under Article 189b(8)) (T04963) COS0449 SEC(96)1225 C4-0464/96 + INST Fond - Exchange of views with Mr Bourlanges and Mr De Giovanni 5.2 Exchange of views with Mrs Fontaine, chairman of the EP delegation to the Conciliation Committee on the difficulties of applying Article 189b (Conciliation Committee) 5.3 Exchange of views with Mr Schwaiger, 'monitor' on the legislative procedures 6. 1997 budget - Section III (T04556) (T04556) BUD0074 COM(96)0300 C4-0350/96 + INST Avis A DELL'ALBA Gianfranco (ARE) F BUDG Fond R BRINKHORST Laurens J (ELD) (PE219.042 ) - Vote on and adoption of draft opinion (PE218.747+AM ) 7. Conference on 'regional and local authorities, participants in political union' (EP and regional authorities) - Draftsman: Gutierrez Diaz - Vote on and adoption of draft opinion (PE218.743+AM ) - Deadline for tabling amendments: 11/09/96 8. Relations between the European Parliament and the national parliaments (T04634) INI0485 INI0485 + INST Fond R NEYTS-UYTTEBROECK An (ELD) (PE218.746 ) - Consideration of working document 9. The constitutional status of European political parties (T04615) INI0471 INI0471 + INST Fond R TSATSOS Dimitrios. (PSE) (PE218.742 ) - Exchange of views and possibly decision on procedure 10. Participation in the institutional system of the EU and IGC by social representatives and other citizens (T04618) [3] INI0474 INI0474 + INST Fond R HERZOG Philippe. (GUE) (PE218.253/A ) - Exchange of views Exchange of views with Mr Manfred Degen (Rhineland-Westphalia) - Exchange of views with Mrs Carola Fischbach-Pyttel (European Public Service Trade Union Federation) - Exchange of views with Mrs Marie-Francoise Wilkinson (European Antipoverty network) - Exchange of views with Mr Jerome Vignon (Forward Studies Unit in the Commission) 11.1 'Monitors' of the Intergovernmental Conference - 1. Citizenship, fundamental rights, uniform electoral procedure: AGLIETTA/Greens - 2. Social dimension and employment and ecological dimension: BARROS MOURA/PSE - 3. CFSP and common defence: SPAAK/ELDR - 4. Opennness, transparency, simplification and codification: BONDE/EDN 11.2 'Monitors' (continued) - 5. Institutions, subsidiarity, flexibility: DELL'ALBA/ARE - 6.-3rd Pillar: CEDERSCHIOLD/PPE - 7. Financing, budget, fraud: MARRA/UPE - 8. Role of the Comittee of the Regions and economic cohesion: GUTIERREZ DIAZ/GUE 12. Application of the 'Modus Vivendi' in the area of commitology - Monitors: Mr Bourlanges and Mr De Giovanni - Consideration of working document 13. Any other business 14. Date of next meeting in Brussels: (PE/XVI/OJ/96-21 ) 14.1

[FOOTNOTES]1. ) This exchange of views will take place on Wednesday 25 September 1996 from 3 to 4.30 pm 2. ) This exchange of views will take place on Wednesday 25 September 1996 from 4.30 pm 3. ) This exchange of views will take place on Thursday 26 September from 3 pm - FIN - T END OF DOCUMENT.
